subject.title: WhatsApp: Add support for querying message reactions

question: What public WhatsApp reaction read/event contract should OpenClaw support for this issue: CLI query/history, plugin hooks, agent-visible events, or a staged combination?
rationale: The source gap is clear, but exposing reactions affects privacy, stored state, plugin API shape, agent-turn semantics, and historical retrieval behavior, so automation should not choose the contract alone.

options.title: Design staged reaction read contract
options.body: Specify a privacy-gated contract first, then implement query/history and event exposure in one coherent WhatsApp plugin path.

options.title: Narrow to plugin hook first
options.body: Treat https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/79996 as the first implementation slice and leave CLI history/query support for a later issue.

options.title: Defer historical retrieval
options.body: Expose only live add/remove reaction events for now and explicitly document that historical WhatsApp reaction querying remains unsupported.

recommendation.title: Design staged reaction read contract
recommendation.body: Specify a privacy-gated contract first, then implement query/history and event exposure in one coherent WhatsApp plugin path.

likelyOwner.reason: This handle has the strongest current-main provenance on the central WhatsApp action/runtime files and already provided prior maintainer-style review context on this issue.
